overviews.name: AUTH
key_points: Decides card authorization requests arriving over MQ: approves or declines each against the available credit of the account and replies on the reply queue.
Keeps approved and declined authorizations as pending records in an IMS database, which operators browse by account and flag as fraud; fraud flags are stored in Db2 table CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS.
Batch jobs purge expired pending authorizations and unload or reload the IMS database.

descriptions.name: CBPAUP0C
descriptions.description: Batch IMS program that walks the pending-authorization database and deletes detail segments older than the expiry-days parameter, then the summary segments left empty.
key_points: Reads each summary root (GN) and its detail children (GNP); a detail qualifies for deletion when today's day number minus the authorization date reaches WS-EXPIRY-DAYS.
Before deleting a detail it subtracts its count and amount from the approved or declined totals of the summary; the summary is deleted when its approved count is zero or less.
Takes an IMS checkpoint each time the processed-summary count passes the checkpoint frequency from the parameter card, and sets return code 16 on abend.

descriptions.name: COPAUA0C
descriptions.description: CICS program that reads card authorization requests from MQ, approves or declines each against available credit, replies over MQ and records the result in the IMS pending-authorization database.
key_points: Started with MQ trigger data (RETRIEVE into MQTM), it opens the request queue and loops over messages, taking a syncpoint after each, until none is left or the per-run limit is passed.
Declines (response '05') when the amount exceeds credit limit minus balance, taken from the IMS summary segment or else the account record, or when no account is found; otherwise approves ('00').
For a card found in the cross-reference it replaces or inserts the summary segment and inserts a detail segment; errors are written to TD queue CSSL.

descriptions.name: COPAUS0C
descriptions.description: CICS screen program (transaction CPVS) that lists the pending authorizations of an account from the IMS database, with paging and selection of one authorization for the detail screen.
key_points: Sends and receives map COPAU0A; Enter looks up the account and its authorizations, PF7/PF8 page backward and forward, PF3 transfers to the menu program.
Selecting a row with 'S' transfers control to the detail program COPAUS1C with the selected authorization key in the COMMAREA.
Reads the card cross-reference, account and customer files and the IMS summary (GU) and detail (GNP) segments to fill the screen.

descriptions.name: COPAUS1C
descriptions.description: CICS screen program (transaction CPVD) that shows one pending authorization in detail and lets the operator mark or unmark it as fraud.
key_points: Reads the selected authorization from the IMS database (GU on the summary, GNP on the detail) and sends map COPAU1A; PF8 reads the next authorization, PF3 returns to the list program COPAUS0C.
PF5 links to COPAUS2C with the authorization record; when that reports success it replaces the IMS detail segment, otherwise it rolls back.

descriptions.name: COPAUS2C
descriptions.description: CICS Db2 program linked from the detail screen that records an authorization's fraud flag in table CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS.
key_points: Inserts the authorization as a row of CARDDEMO.AUTHFRDS; on SQLCODE -803 (row already there) it updates the fraud flag and report date instead.
Returns a success or failure flag and message to the caller in the COMMAREA.

descriptions.name: DBUNLDGS
descriptions.description: Batch IMS program that unloads the pending-authorization database, writing each summary root and each detail child to two GSAM output databases.
key_points: Reads roots with GN and their children with GNP through CBLTDLI and inserts each into the root GSAM PCB (PASFLPCB) or the child GSAM PCB (PADFLPCB).
Sets return code 16 on abend.

descriptions.name: PAUDBLOD
descriptions.description: Batch IMS program that loads the pending-authorization database from two sequential files: root summary segments from INFILE1, child detail segments from INFILE2.
key_points: Inserts each INFILE1 record as a root segment; for each INFILE2 record it positions on the root with GU and inserts the child. A segment already in the database is reported, not treated as an error.
Sets return code 16 on abend.

descriptions.name: PAUDBUNL
descriptions.description: Batch IMS program that unloads the pending-authorization database to two sequential files: root summary segments to OUTFIL1, child detail segments to OUTFIL2.
key_points: Reads roots with GN and their children with GNP through CBLTDLI and writes one record per segment.
Sets return code 16 on abend.

descriptions.name: CBPAUP0J
descriptions.description: Runs CBPAUP0C as an IMS BMP under PSB PSBPAUTB to delete expired pending authorizations, with the expiry and checkpoint parameters on an in-stream card.

descriptions.name: DBPAUTP0
descriptions.description: Deletes the previous unload dataset, then runs the IMS unload utility DFSURGU0 against database DBPAUTP0 into AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.IMSDATA.DBPAUTP0.

descriptions.name: LOADPADB
descriptions.description: Runs PAUDBLOD as an IMS BMP under PSB PSBPAUTB to load the pending-authorization database from the root and child unload files.

descriptions.name: UNLDGSAM
descriptions.description: Runs DBUNLDGS in an IMS DLI region under PSB DLIGSAMP to unload the pending-authorization database into the root and child GSAM datasets.

descriptions.name: UNLDPADB
descriptions.description: Deletes the previous root and child unload files, then runs PAUDBUNL in an IMS DLI region under PSB PAUTBUNL to unload the pending-authorization database into them.
